ja255:1.1: The bird, who knew the measure in food, for as long
ja255:2.1: But because of swallowing food excessively,
ja255:2.3: Then he sank down right there,
ja255:3.1: Therefore knowing the measure in food is good,
ja255:3.3: By not knowing the measure they sink,
ja255:3.4: knowing it they do not sink.
